title: Exotic Sweet Venezuelan Palm Sugar Empanadas
description: Indulgent Venezuelan dish featuring palm sugar, nam tan pip, and a briny glassy jelly filling, fried to perfection and suitable for a low glycemic diet
instructions: Combine palm sugar, flour, and salt in a large bowl.
Add eggs, water, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of briny glassy jelly in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Fry the empanadas until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve warm.
Dust with powdered palm sugar before serving.
